dataset.primary: Thompson (1917) Fig. 320 Ovis ammon lateral drawing, IA ongrowthform1917thom leaf 641

registry_named.status: DATASET_MISMATCH_FOR_SHAPE - species match (Ovis, Capra), variables do not (horn length vs body mass only). Labelled analogue; not used for the verdict.

verdict_basis: Pass 1: single digitised Thompson figure; criteria in reference.json acceptance_criteria

acceptance_criteria.log_spiral_supported_if: Pearson r(ln rho, theta) >= 0.95 on the outer edge AND the log spiral beats the circle by delta-AIC >= 10 on both Ovis ammon sources
acceptance_criteria.alpha_matches_thompson_if: fitted alpha within +/- 5 deg of 75 deg (Ovis ammon) and < 70 deg (Capra)
